findings.title: WebSocket state_update snapshots overwrite initial HTTP 15-minute forecast with null and clear upstream HTTP error banners unconditionally
findings.details: In App.tsx, onmessage treats every valid 'state_update' WebSocket message as a complete reading replacement via applyReading(nextReading) and clears httpError. As documented in claudedocs/design/ui-dashboard-audit-2026-10-30.md:120-125, the backend state_update event does not include predicted_load_15min, so any forecast obtained from GET /api/adhd-state drops to null ('unknown') on the first live socket event. Additionally, setHttpError(null) clears partial upstream error warnings from the initial GET even if the socket update also omits those fields.

findings.title: Restored ESLint flat config leaves pre-existing lint errors unresolved and unguarded in CI
findings.details: ui-dashboard/eslint.config.js restores ESLint v9/v10 flat configuration, but claudedocs/design/ui-dashboard-audit-2026-10-30.md:27-37 and 131-132 document that linting still fails with 16 errors and 2 warnings on pre-existing code in ui-dashboard/src and that no GitHub Actions workflow runs ui-dashboard lint or unit tests.

findings.title: TaskSequencer and TeamDashboard remain backed by static sample data
findings.details: TaskSequencer.tsx and TeamDashboard.tsx (lines 99-113) relabel their headers to '[SAMPLE] not connected' instead of '[LIVE]', resolving the false live-sync claim, but both components remain unwired to live backend task/team endpoints.

risks: Candidate validation (tsc, eslint, vitest, vite build) was not executed in this embedded audit because tools and candidate execution are disabled by audit policy (validation_status=NOT_RUN).
No CI workflow currently enforces ui-dashboard typecheck, lint, or vitest suites on pull requests, and 16 pre-existing lint errors remain in untouched component regions.
Live WebSocket state_update payloads reset the 15-minute load prediction readout to 'unknown' until the backend includes predicted_load_15min in ws/state messages.
rationale: Repository (DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp), PR (1486), head SHA (0c031b26589f5ae07bc1a6801387b7c02f8e73ff), and base SHA (97b6d5040496e2271c41d24c339d039303bbe6b1) match trusted authority metadata, and the deterministic scanner detected no instruction-like content. The candidate diff across 22 files replaces fabricated fallback cognitive state readings (0.7/0.6/0.5) with explicit nullable readings in cognitiveReading.ts, guards against out-of-range ratios and invalid enum values, suppresses leaked upstream recommender error strings when task_recommendations contains an error object, prevents slow initial HTTP GET responses or errors from clobbering newer WebSocket state updates via liveReadingSeenRef in App.tsx, detaches WebSocket event handlers before closing sockets on effect cleanup, normalizes zone-less UTC timestamps in time.ts, and replaces CognitiveLoadGauge and PredictionPanel with LoadInstrument, AttentionStatePanel, and SignalFeed backed by new unit and integration test suites. Remaining issues are non-blocking follow-up items and unexecuted runtime validation.
